user_goal: Evaluate whether authorized livestream highlight clipping should become a permanent AI Army monetization lane, and identify adjacent AI-automation businesses with strong revenue potential.

facts: Reused content without significant original commentary, substantive modification, or educational/entertainment value is ineligible.
The policy applies to the whole channel.
Monetizable examples include critical-review clips, explained sports replays, reactions with commentary, and footage edited with a new story/commentary.
Mass-produced/repetitive inauthentic content is not monetizable.
Non-original unedited clips, reuploads, and compilations without original content are ineligible engaged views for Shorts revenue sharing.
Shorts monetization remains subject to reused-content, copyright, terms, and advertiser-friendly rules.
Creators need commercial-use rights for all audio/video elements.
For another person's content, YouTube says written explicit commercial-use permission is required.
Fair use is fact-specific and commercial purpose can weigh against it.
Content ID may block, monetize for the rightsholder, or track matched segments, possibly by territory.
Qualifying videos must be original, high quality, and longer than one minute.
Original content for the program excludes Duets, Stitches, and sponsored content.

fresh_primary_evidence.source: TikTok Creator Rewards Program terms for Japan/Korea
facts: Japan is covered; eligibility includes age/follower/view requirements.
Eligible videos are at least one minute; creators are responsible for ownership, originality, copyright, neighboring rights, voice and likeness rights.
Automation that artificially inflates engagement is prohibited.
Copyright-infringing content is not allowed absent authorization or valid legal exception.
Repeat infringement can lead to bans.
TikTok Shop launched in Japan on 2025-06-30.
Over 70% of GMV through 2026-06-30 originated from content such as short videos and LIVE streams.
The program is available to eligible Japan-based creators.
Eligibility requires YPP and the applicable subscriber threshold plus other channel restrictions.
An open-source implementation combines chat density, emotion keywords, speech-chat overlap, smoothing and peak detection.
It uses local faster-whisper and review-before-export.
WhisperX provides word-level timestamps, forced alignment, VAD, batching and optional diarization for precise clip boundaries/captions.
Auto-Editor can cut on loudness and motion with configurable margins for dead-space removal.

Creator-owned content repurposing: livestream/podcast to Shorts/TikTok/Reels with captions, context, commentary and CTA
Managed clipping service for small creators where the source creator owns the footage
AI-assisted shopping review content using creator-owned footage plus YouTube Shopping/TikTok Shop affiliate monetization
Original AI news/explainer short-form channel with source citations and human editorial control
Local-business short-video production using client-provided footage
Digital product/course funnel from original long-form expertise content
B2B content repurposing agency for webinars/podcasts with client permission
